prompt: Edit the supplied single blank Loot & Lore parchment cutout. Keep exactly the reference sheet's aspect ratio, straight-on flat alignment, warm tan palette, candlelight, quiet mottled central area and painterly aged fibre. Keep all strong damage at the perimeter, except flat creases or tide lines if specified.
